incidents.summary: Hollywood Bowl admitted a technical breach of the Companies Act 2006 after paying a dividend and making share buy-backs without first filing the required interim accounts, which it subsequently filed on 28 February 2025.

sources.title: Publication of Circular and Notice of GM | Company Announcement | Investegate
sources.quote: This has resulted in a technical infringement of the Companies Act 2006 (the " Act").

sources.title: Publication of Circular and Notice of GM | Company Announcement | Investegate
sources.quote: the Company omitted to deliver those interim accounts to Companies House to satisfy the procedural requirements of the Act before making the Relevant Distributions.

sources.title: Publication of Circular and Notice of GM | Company Announcement | Investegate
sources.quote: The relevant interim accounts were delivered to Companies House on 28 February 2025.
